types.name: Bounds
types.doc: Read-only axis-aligned bounds captured by a scene snapshot.

types.name: Camera
types.doc: Owns one scene camera asset.

types.name: CameraData
types.doc: Value builder for a perspective or orthographic scene camera.

types.name: ChangeSet
types.doc: Immutable transaction result describing the changed scene domains.

types.name: Geometry
types.doc: Owns one geometry resource ID in a Scene.

types.name: GeometryData
types.doc: Owns the backing arrays used to describe one geometry resource.

fields.name: box
fields.doc: Describes a box primitive; native SceneKit generates its faces, normals, and edges.

fields.name: addStream
fields.doc: Adds one tightly packed or explicitly strided vertex attribute stream.

fields.name: addStrokeSegment
fields.doc: Adds one object-space centerline segment for the analytic GPU stroke pass.

fields.name: clearStrokeSegments
fields.doc: Replace display strokes without changing triangle topology or face IDs.

fields.name: stream
fields.doc: Read a stream without copying it, for overlays on the same tessellation.

fields.name: subelementGeometry
fields.doc:
Builds a renderable geometry containing only one subelement's triangles.
This is used for face overlays while retaining the source vertex streams.

fields.name: setIndexBuffer
fields.doc: Supplies a tightly packed uint32 index stream without per-index Haxe allocations.

types.name: GeometryStream
types.doc: Borrowed vertex stream; callers must keep its bytes immutable.

types.name: Image
types.doc: Owns one scene image asset.

types.name: ImageData
types.doc: Value builder for one scene-owned image asset.

types.name: Light
types.doc: Owns one scene light asset.

types.name: LightData
types.doc: Value builder for a directional, point, or spot scene light.

types.name: Material
types.doc: Owns one material resource ID in a Scene.

types.name: MaterialData
types.doc: Fluent value builder for one material resource.

types.name: NodeId
types.doc: Stable identity for one positioned item in a scene hierarchy.

fields.name: stableValue
fields.doc: Returns the stable 64-bit node value for logging or maps.

types.name: PerspectiveCamera
types.doc: Testable orbit camera state shared by perspective input and rendering.

fields.name: fitClipRange
fields.doc: Fits the depth range to visible world-space axis-aligned bounds.

fields.name: orbitAround
fields.doc:
Rotate around a world point without recentering it or changing the zoom.
Rotating both the eye and view target preserves the pivot's screen position.

fields.name: look
fields.doc: Mouse-look turns around the eye rather than orbiting the target.

fields.name: fly
fields.doc: Translate in view-forward/right and world-up directions, with normalized diagonal speed.

fields.name: setTarget
fields.doc: Explicit metric focus, including small-part inspection below the navigation zoom floor.

fields.name: setAngle
fields.doc: Set a standard camera angle without changing the current focus or zoom.

fields.name: zoomAt
fields.doc: Zoom around a world anchor, keeping its projected position fixed.

fields.name: cursorAnchor
fields.doc: Cursor anchor on the plane through the orbit target, parallel to the screen.

fields.name: frame
fields.signature: (centerX:Float, centerY:Float, centerZ:Float, width:Float, height:Float, depth:Float, aspect:Float):Void

fields.name: studioDirection
fields.doc: Rotate a camera-space direction toward a light into world coordinates.

fields.name: screenRay
fields.doc: Builds a world-space camera ray through a viewport pixel.

fields.name: projectWithMatrix
fields.doc: Projects a point using the same immutable matrix as the other points in this paint.

fields.name: projectSegment
fields.signature: (x0:Float, y0:Float, z0:Float, x1:Float, y1:Float, z1:Float, width:Float, height:Float):Null<Array<PerspectiveScreenPoint>>
fields.doc: Projects the visible part of a world-space line after clipping it to the camera frustum.

fields.name: projectSegmentWithMatrix
fields.signature: (matrix:Transform, x0:Float, y0:Float, z0:Float, x1:Float, y1:Float, z1:Float, width:Float, height:Float):Null<Array<PerspectiveScreenPoint>>
fields.doc: Uses one frame's projection for multiple lines in the same viewport.

types.name: PickPollResult
types.doc: Result of polling an asynchronous GPU pick request.

types.name: PickRequest
types.doc: Owns one asynchronous GPU ID-pass readback.

fields.name: poll
fields.doc: Polls without blocking. The request is valid until disposed.

types.name: PickResult
types.doc: Typed Haxe result for one renderer picking query.

fields.name: node
fields.doc: Picked scene node.

types.name: Sampler
types.doc: Owns one scene sampler asset.

types.name: SamplerData
types.doc: Value builder for scene sampler state.

types.name: Scene
types.doc: Owns one mutable NativeKit scene and its explicitly created resources.

fields.name: createGeometryBatch
fields.doc: Creates geometry resources from one batch and publishes them together.

fields.name: createMaterialBatch
fields.doc: Creates material resources from one batch and publishes them together.

fields.name: dispose
fields.doc: Disposes child resources before releasing the scene handle.

types.name: SceneFrame
types.doc:
Owns the immutable snapshot and optional change set for one renderable
scene frame.

A frame keeps both native values alive until the render boundary has
consumed them. The change set may be null for an initial or explicitly
refreshed frame.

fields.name: snapshot
fields.doc: Creates a frame from the scene's current published state.

fields.name: sceneSnapshot
fields.doc: Returns the immutable scene state retained by this frame.

fields.name: changeSet
fields.doc: Returns the commit delta, or null when this frame has no delta.

fields.name: dispose
fields.doc: Releases the change set and snapshot in dependency-safe order.

types.name: SceneNode
types.doc: Immutable node state captured by a scene snapshot.

types.name: SceneRenderer
types.doc:
Keeps render-plan and NativeKit GPU synchronization behind one explicit
render boundary. Scene snapshots and change sets are owned by the caller.

fields.name: create
fields.doc: Creates an executor for a live renderer handle. Keep its owner alive.

fields.name: createHeadless
fields.doc: Creates the headless resource/command executor used by tests and tools.

fields.name: createBorrowedId
fields.doc: Creates an executor around a caller-owned opaque renderer ID.

fields.name: render
fields.doc: Compiles, refreshes, or incrementally updates the plan, then executes it.

fields.name: captureRgba8
fields.doc: Renders through the GPU into tightly packed RGBA8 pixels.

fields.name: setSampleCount
fields.doc:
Sets how many samples rendered images use and returns the count that will be used.
One means no multisampling, which is the default. The request is clamped to what the
GPU can render and resolve and rounded down to a power of two. Picking is never
multisampled, and the image returned by renderImage() is always single-sample: the
multisampled result is resolved into it.

fields.name: maxSampleCount
fields.doc: The largest sample count this GPU can render and resolve for rendered images.

fields.name: renderImage
fields.doc: Renders directly into a retained, backend-neutral GPU image.

fields.name: renderFrame
fields.doc: Renders one owned frame, including its optional incremental change set.

fields.name: lastUpdate
fields.doc: Returns the last plan update metrics, or null before the first update.

fields.name: hasPlan
fields.doc: Reports whether this renderer has compiled a render plan yet.

fields.name: pickPixel
fields.doc: Performs a GPU ID pass and resolves one pixel to scene ownership.

fields.name: pickPixelAsync
fields.doc: Starts a non-blocking GPU ID pass and pixel readback.

types.name: SceneSession
types.doc:
Thin Haxeon owner for the NativeKit scene/render frame loop.

The session owns the mutable scene, render boundary, and reusable view.
Individual SceneFrame values remain caller-owned so an application can
retain immutable frames for asynchronous work.

fields.name: createHeadless
fields.doc: Creates a session using the headless resource and command executor.

fields.name: create
fields.doc: Creates a session attached to an externally owned GPU renderer.

fields.name: view
fields.doc: Returns the reusable view applied to subsequent render calls.

fields.name: snapshotFrame
fields.doc: Captures the current published scene without a change set.

fields.name: commit
fields.doc: Commits a transaction and captures its corresponding render frame.

fields.name: render
fields.doc: Executes the current render plan against one immutable frame.

fields.name: pickPixel
fields.doc: Performs a synchronous pixel pick against one immutable frame.

fields.name: pickPixelAsync
fields.doc: Starts an asynchronous pixel pick against one immutable frame.

types.name: SceneSnapshot
types.doc: Immutable read-only scene state captured at one scene revision.

fields.name: nodes
fields.doc: Returns all published scene nodes.

fields.name: nodesForSource
fields.doc: Returns nodes associated with one source entity.

fields.name: nodesForGeometry
fields.doc: Returns nodes associated with one geometry resource.

fields.name: nodesForMaterial
fields.doc: Returns nodes associated with one material resource.

types.name: SceneView
types.doc: Immutable-at-render-boundary view configuration with typed overrides.

fields.name: setViewProjection
fields.doc: Enables bounds culling and applies a column-major world-to-clip matrix.

fields.name: clearViewProjection
fields.doc: Disables bounds culling and restores the default identity projection.

fields.name: setCameraViewPose
fields.doc: Supplies the exact eye and view direction for an explicit projection.

fields.name: setWorkplaneGrid
fields.doc:
Renders an infinite z=0 grid behind scene geometry for editor views.
Forward, right, and up are world-space ray basis vectors; right/up include
the camera's field-of-view scale for clip-space coordinates in [-1, 1].

fields.name: setStudioLighting
fields.doc: Sets three world-space directions, intensities, and optional RGB light colors.

fields.name: setStudioDetail
fields.doc: Display-only depth AO and highlight broadening. Radius uses scene world units; zero strength disables AO.

fields.name: setCameraNode
fields.doc: Selects a scene camera node when no explicit matrix is set.

fields.name: addClipPlane
fields.doc: Adds a conservative node-level section plane. Kept side is normal * p + distance >= 0.

fields.name: setPose
fields.doc: Adds or replaces a runtime world-space pose without changing the scene snapshot.

fields.name: replacePoses
fields.doc: Replaces all world-space poses with one native publication.

fields.name: setDiagnosticTint
fields.doc: Tints a diagnostic subtree without replacing its material; selection and hover win.

fields.name: setSourceVisibility
fields.doc: Adds or replaces a source-level visibility rule.

fields.name: setSourceMaterial
fields.doc: Adds or replaces a source-level base material rule.

fields.name: setIsolatedSource
fields.doc: Adds or removes a source from the declarative isolation set.

fields.name: setIsolatedNode
fields.doc: Adds or removes an explicit node from the isolation set.

fields.name: clearIsolation
fields.doc: Clears source and explicit node isolation while preserving rules.

fields.name: applyPolicy
fields.doc: Applies reusable base visibility and material presentation rules.

fields.name: applySelection
fields.doc: Tints selected subtrees with highlight RGB while retaining each surface material.

fields.name: applyHover
fields.doc: Tints a hovered subtree; preserves source alpha and takes precedence over selection.

fields.name: applyHoverNodes
fields.doc: Replaces the hover layer with every node of one object that is drawn as several.

types.name: SceneViewFilter
types.doc:
Native scene-view presentation filter.

SourceEntityFilter remains available as a compatibility subclass for code
written before this value had its SceneView-oriented name.

fields.name: isolateSource
fields.doc: Replaces the isolation set with one source.

fields.name: isolateSources
fields.doc: Replaces the isolation set with the supplied sources.

fields.name: applyTo
fields.doc: Applies the source rules directly to a reusable view.

fields.name: apply
fields.doc: Applies declarative source rules to a view policy.

types.name: SceneViewPolicy
types.doc:
Reusable base presentation rules for a SceneView.

Policies are composable: apply them in order and a later rule for the same
node replaces an earlier rule in the same layer. ScenePresentation applies
selection and hover from SceneInteraction into SceneView's transient layers.

fields.name: hideSubtree
fields.doc: Visibility follows the node hierarchy, so this affects descendants.

fields.name: showSubtree
fields.doc: Restores this subtree unless another ancestor policy keeps it hidden.

fields.name: setSourceVisibility
fields.doc: Adds or replaces a source-level visibility rule.

fields.name: setSourceMaterial
fields.doc: Adds or replaces a source-level base material rule.

fields.name: isolateSource
fields.doc: Replaces the source isolation set with one source.

fields.name: isolateSources
fields.doc: Replaces the source isolation set with the supplied sources.

fields.name: apply
fields.doc: Applies this policy without disturbing other view layers.

types.name: SelectionSet
types.doc: Reusable set of subtrees to tint without replacing their surface materials.

types.name: SourceEntityFilter
types.doc:
Compatibility name for source-entity presentation rules.

New code can use SceneViewFilter; this subclass keeps existing Haxeon call
sites source-compatible while sharing the same implementation.

types.name: SpatialIndex
types.doc: Read-only spatial queries and CPU ray picking for one scene snapshot.

fields.name: updateNode
fields.doc: Refit this index after a transform-only update to one existing node.

fields.name: updateNodes
fields.doc: Refits all changed bounds, or advances a metadata-only snapshot with an empty array.

fields.name: queryBounds
fields.doc: Returns nodes whose snapshot bounds overlap the supplied box.

fields.name: queryRay
fields.doc: Returns nodes whose snapshot bounds intersect the supplied ray.

fields.name: pickRay
fields.doc: Returns the nearest visible triangle hit, including source and subelement identity.

fields.name: pickRayWithView
fields.signature: (view:SceneView, originX:Float, originY:Float, originZ:Float, directionX:Float, directionY:Float, directionZ:Float):PickResult
fields.doc: Picks the presented view using this retained scene index and its current pose overrides.

fields.name: pickRayWithViewEdges
fields.signature: (view:SceneView, originX:Float, originY:Float, originZ:Float, directionX:Float, directionY:Float, directionZ:Float, angularTolerance:Float):PickResult

types.name: Texture
types.doc: Owns one scene texture asset.

types.name: TextureData
types.doc: Value builder connecting a scene texture to an image asset.

types.name: Transaction
types.doc: Records scene mutations until commit or cancellation.

fields.name: setSourceEntity
fields.doc: Associates an node with a source entity; zero clears the association.

fields.name: commitFrame
fields.doc: Commits this transaction and retains its snapshot/delta as one frame.

types.name: Transform
types.doc: Small value builder for column-major scene transforms.

fields.name: multiplied
fields.doc: Compose a local transform after this parent/world transform.

types.name: TransformUpdate
types.doc: One node transform in a bulk transaction update.

types.name: VisibilityFilter
types.doc: Reusable per-node visibility policy for a SceneView.

types.name: GizmoBasis
types.doc: Immutable right-handed orthonormal movement axes; scale never changes handle size or snap units.

fields.name: fromQuaternion
fields.doc: Rotation only, from a finite nonzero quaternion. Normalize without inheriting object/parent scale.

types.name: GizmoCamera
types.doc: Frozen perspective pose, suitable for capture from PerspectiveCamera's public eye/target/FOV.

types.name: GizmoPoint
types.doc: Logical viewport pixels and positive eye-space depth.

types.name: GizmoShapeHit
types.doc: Shared capsule/convex-pad hit geometry in logical pixels.

types.name: GizmoVec3
types.doc: Immutable Float64 geometry, independent of scene entities and rendering.

types.name: RotationDrag
types.doc: Signed angle about a frozen World axis, unwrapped across the atan2 boundary.

types.name: RotationGizmo
types.doc: Frozen axis rings. Perspective logical pixels; no scene, source or UI ownership.

types.name: RotationShape
types.doc: Owned projected ring polyline used identically by drawing and picking.

types.name: ScaleDrag
types.doc: Absolute dimensionless factor from pointer-down; invalid/zero/negative factors retain the last proposal.

types.name: ScaleGizmo
types.doc: Positive local-axis and uniform scale factors, using frozen screen geometry.

types.name: ScaleHandle
types.doc: Local axis factors or uniform scaling about the selected pivot.

types.name: ScaleShape
types.doc: Owned axis shaft or center pad; drawing and picking use the same points.

types.name: TranslationDrag
types.doc: Frozen constraint producing absolute World displacement from pointer-down.

types.name: TranslationGizmo
types.doc: Immutable translation layout and synchronous handle picker. No scene or UI ownership.

fields.name: translatedShapes
fields.doc: Follow a proposal while retaining pointer-down size, visible handles and camera.

types.name: TranslationShape
types.doc: Two points draw an axis; four draw a plane pad. Picking uses these same primitives.
